# Thalys Dev

> Estúdio de Luis Thalys para construir MVP, app e SaaS do brief ao produto no ar, com ownership full stack do ciclo.

Thalys Dev is a one-person digital product studio. Luis Thalys designs and builds web and mobile products end to end: landing pages, portfolio sites, company sites, simple e-commerce, MVPs, apps, and SaaS. Stack in production includes React, Node.js, TypeScript, React Native, Nest.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Docker. Based in Nova Santa Rita, RS, Brazil. Typical response time: within 24 hours.

## Site

- [Home](https://thalysdev.com/): positioning, services, projects, contact
- [Projects](https://thalysdev.com/projects): public case list and project details
- [Contact](https://thalysdev.com/#contact): form, email, WhatsApp

## Services

- Landing page
- Portfolio site
- Company / institutional site
- Simple e-commerce
- MVP, app, and SaaS (end-to-end build)

Price ranges and typical timelines are published on the home page services section and may change with scope.
